title: Tell the reader the verifier sees only the candidate tree, not base runs
summary: Root cause: the reader was told which commands the verifier runs but not that it sees only the final tree, so criteria asked for base-vs-candidate runs or the producer's transcript. Fix it in the reader brief's "What the verifier can run" section (information first), and widen the producer-evidence phrase list by two nouns. Jobs 20261027-004517-gk9e, -011733-vrsk and -012938-yckz are addressed as examples of the class.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria check the brief text a reader receives and a test that fails without the change.
fmt, clippy and test criteria included.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/reading/surveys.rs (check_criteria_evidence, producer_evidence_phrase, REPORT_NOUNS, run at crates/athena-core/src/reading/checks.rs:538 during reading acceptance), crates/athena-context/src/briefs/reader.rs (verifier_can_run_section, criteria_judging_section) and crates/athena-core/src/reading/retry.rs (revert_for revert runs already exist as Athena's 'fails without the fix' evidence). No record or data file is added, so check_record_file and AnyRecord are not touched. The property is measured directly: the rendered reader brief text and check_criteria_evidence's result on sample criteria.

Goal and audience: readers (the reader role) who write criteria, and the verifier who must judge them. Criteria that need a run on the base commit, a before/after comparison of command output, or the producer's transcript cannot be judged: the verifier sees only the candidate tree, diff and recorded checks (jobs 20261027-004517-gk9e, 20261027-011733-vrsk, 20261027-012938-yckz showed this).

Previous jobs: 20261027-004517-gk9e (fail: report not visible) and 20261027-011733-vrsk (no change) are addressed by the cause, not by redoing their work; 20261027-012938-yckz already landed and passed. Their candidate files crates/athena-core/src/gh/mod.rs and gh/transport.rs are kept as landed and not touched here; CHANGELOG.md is a deliverable of this job.

The existing phrase check already refuses 'the producer's report lists ...'; the new brief text gives the reader the missing list rather than adding a refusal, and the added nouns (transcript, log) are a small extension. Expected 1% of newly refused readings.
No config or workflow file needs a change; consumers of the changed brief text are only the reader prompt assembly.

acceptance_criteria.text: The text rendered by verifier_can_run_section in crates/athena-context/src/briefs/reader.rs states that the verifier sees only the final candidate tree, cannot check out or run anything on the base commit, and that a before/after comparison or 'fails without the fix' criterion is met only by the diff or by a recorded Athena revert-run check, never by the verifier's own base run.

crates/athena-core/src/reading/surveys.rs producer_evidence_phrase also refuses criteria citing the producer's transcript or log, and its doc comment names the root cause (no defined list of verifier-observable evidence).

Run `cargo test --locked`: a new brief test fails on the base tree and passes now, asserting the reader brief contains the final-tree-only statement; a new reading test asserts check_criteria_evidence refuses a criterion citing 'the producer's transcript' and still accepts 'Grep over crates/ returns 0 hits'.
Run `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`; Athena's recorded checks on the final tree pass.
CHANGELOG.md has a new entry naming the root cause; expected 1% of newly refused readings.

out_of_scope: crates/athena-core/src/gh/mod.rs and gh/transport.rs (the structure-pass G2 move, already landed by 20261027-012938-yckz)
Building new revert-run or base-tree-run machinery in Athena's checks
Edits to athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows, docs/decisions.md or records/
Changes to the reader's frame prompt file (2 tokens headroom)
hard_reason: It touches the reading-acceptance rule check_criteria_evidence, which can refuse work, and the reader brief of the run pipeline.
